name: Special Characters
description: Type ε₀, ℵ₀, ω, Ω and other Greek/math symbols in Geometry Dash text fields using short codes like \e0, \a0, \w and \W.

enable-codes.name: Enable typing codes
enable-codes.description: Typing the prefix followed by a code (for example \e0) turns it into the symbol. Codes: e0 or eps0 = ε₀, a0 or aleph0 = ℵ₀, w = ω, W = Ω, alpha beta gamma delta theta lambda mu pi sigma phi = Greek letters, inf = ∞.

prefix.name: Code prefix
prefix.description: The character(s) you type before a code. Default is a backslash.
